Among them was He Yi, Binance’s co-chief executive, who is seven months pregnant, and worked through the night from her base in Abu Dhabi, taking a call at 3 a.m. local time. 后来，他们转而召开大型电话会议，屏幕上显示着100个视频窗口。员工们轮流关闭和打开麦克风，时而说英语，时而说中文。参与者中包括币安联席首席执行官何一。怀孕七个月的她在阿布扎比的办公地点彻夜工作，当地时间凌晨3点还在接听电话。 Ms. He and her colleagues were navigating one of the most damaging crises in Binance’s long and troubled history. A team of North Korean hackers had penetrated the exchange and drained more than $6 billion in the largest crypto heist of all time. Binance was forced to halt deposits and withdrawals, and posted a series of frantic messages on X, promising that it would cover any losses. 何一和她的同事们正在应对币安漫长而风波不断的历史上最具破坏性的危机之一。一个朝鲜黑客团队侵入了这家交易所， 盗走逾60亿美元 ，制造了有史以来规模最大的加密货币盗窃案。币安被迫暂停充值和提现，并在X平台上发布一系列措辞急切的消息，承诺承担所有损失。 It was a surreal situation made even more surreal by the actions of Binance’s founder, Changpeng Zhao , who spent the evening narrating the events to his 12.9 million followers on X. He posted prayer hand emojis, publicly jousted with the site’s owner, Elon Musk, and insisted that “user funds are SAFU” — using a bit of crypto slang to reassure customers that hundreds of millions of dollars in deposits would not simply vanish into thin air. 这场危机本已令人难以置信，而币安创始人 赵长鹏 的举动又给它增添了几分超现实色彩。他整晚都在X平台上向自己的1290万名粉丝实时讲述事态进展。他 发布 双手合十的表情符号，与X平台所有者埃隆·马斯克公开交锋，还 坚称 “用户资金SAFU”，这是借用币圈的行话向客户保证，他们数亿美元的存款不会凭空消失。 “It hurts, but we will survive,” Mr. Zhao declared. “这很痛苦，但我们会挺过去的。”赵长鹏宣称。 币安创始人赵长鹏，摄于8月。黑客攻击当晚，他通宵在X上向1290万粉丝描述事件进展。 The impact of the Binance attack rippled across the crypto industry , from Abu Dhabi to New York, setting off a frantic effort to salvage some of the stolen funds and prompting law enforcement inquiries. This account of how the hack unfolded is based on interviews with four people with knowledge of the events, as well as analyses by crypto forensics firms and documents reviewed by The New York Times. 币安遭受攻击的影响 波及整个加密货币行业 ，从阿布扎比到纽约，各方慌忙采取紧急行动，试图追回部分被盗资金，也促使执法机构开始介入调查。基于对四名知情人士的采访、加密货币取证公司的分析，以及《纽约时报》查阅的相关文件，本文对这场黑客攻击经过进行了还原。 For years, Binance has been the most important and contentious company in the crypto world. (Mr. Zhao is Binance’s majority shareholder but doesn’t have a formal role at the company.) 赵长鹏的这番话引起了币安联席首席执行官何一的注意。何一也是他多年的伴侣。（赵长鹏是币安的控股股东，但并未在公司担任正式职务。） “Our company’s revenue for the year is sufficient to cover the losses, so we do not yet need to sell the SpaceX shares,” Ms. He wrote. “我们公司今年的收入足以覆盖这次损失，因此目前还不需要出售SpaceX的股份。”何一写道。 With the industry reeling, Ms. He and her co-chief executive, Richard Teng, told Binance employees to “stay disciplined,” according to a message reviewed by The Times. 据《纽约时报》看到的一条内部信息，在行业震荡之际，何一和联合首席执行官邓伟政要求币安员工要“严守纪律”。 "Do not speculate internally or externally,” the message said. “We know this is an intense moment, and we deeply appreciate everyone working overtime to make this right.” “无论在公司内外，都不要妄加猜测，”信息写道。“我们知道现在形势严峻，非常感谢大家加班加点，努力解决问题。” They also tried to address the growing unease in the crypto world. Speaking in Mandarin in a video posted to X on Friday, Ms. He said that the rise of artificial intelligence had turned hacking into “a threat to the entire industry.” 他们还试图回应币圈日益加剧的不安。周五在X发布的一段 视频 中，何一用普通话表示，人工智能的兴起已使黑客攻击成为“整个行业的威胁”。 “Of course, there are many things that we have done wrong,” she said. “We should have invested in security much earlier and more extensively, and established more rigorous standards.” “当然，我们也有很多做得不对的地方。”她说，“我们应该更早地、更多地去做安全投入，建立更严谨的标准。” Word of Binance’s hack even reached Mr. Trump, who was asked about it by a reporter on Friday. “People never see the money anymore,” he said. “I’ve always felt it was a little bit dangerous. But they say they have it pretty much under control. We’ll see.” 币安被攻击的消息甚至传到了特朗普那里，周五有记者问及此事。“人们再也看不到钱了，”他说。“我一直觉得这有点危险。但他们说基本控制住了。我们拭目以待。” Among the companies that rushed to Binance’s aid was the Trump family firm, World Liberty, the issuer of a coin known as USD1. 在迅速向币安伸出援手的公司中，包括特朗普家族的世界自由金融。这家公司发行了一种名为USD1的数字货币。 Zach Witkoff, the company’s chief executive and the son of one of Mr. Trump’s top advisers, announced on X that World Liberty had frozen $27 million in USD1 that was “associated with the Binance hack.” 该公司首席执行官扎克·威特科夫是特朗普一名高级顾问的儿子。他在X平台宣布，世界自由金融已冻结价值2700万美元与“币安黑客攻击事件有关”的USD1。 “We stand by our industry partners,” he wrote. “我们坚定支持业内合作伙伴。”他写道。 “Thank you!” Mr. Zhao responded , followed by three prayer hand emojis. “谢谢！”赵长鹏回复道，后面跟着三个双手合十的表情符号。 傅才德(Michael Forsythe)和Dustin Volz对本文有报道贡献。 David Yaffe-Bellany 自纽约为时报报道加密货币行业新闻。可以通过电子邮件联系他： davidyb@nytimes.com 翻译：杜然 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: 中国前副总理刘延东去世：跻身共产党高层的少数女性之一
items.description: 艾莎2026年11月2日中国前副总理、曾任该国最高级别女官员之一的刘延东于上周三在北京逝世。 Stanley Chou/Getty Images Liu Yandong, one of the few women to reach the upper echelons of the Chinese Communist Party, but whose career also illustrated the limits for women in China’s ruling elite, died on Wednesday in Beijing. She was 80. 刘延东是极少数几位跻身中国共产党高层的女性之一，但其职业生涯也凸显了中国统治精英阶层中女性所面临的局限。她于上周三在北京逝世，享年80岁。 Her death, after a long illness, was reported by the state news agency Xinhua and confirmed by her family. 据官方通讯社新华社报道，她因长期患病去世，其家属已证实这一消息。 Ms. Liu’s revolutionary pedigree, prestigious education and time toiling in a factory helped pave the way for her rise in the 1980s. As one of just six women to have ever served on the Politburo, the party’s elite policymaking body, she demonstrated what women in politics could achieve, spearheading diplomatic efforts and gaining recognition for her personal approach. 刘延东的革命家世、名校教育背景，以及在工厂辛勤工作的经历为她在20世纪80年代的崛起铺平了道路。作为迄今为止仅有的六位曾任该党最高决策机构中共中央政治局委员的女性之一，她展示了女性在政治领域可以取得的成就，不仅领导了外交工作，并因其个人作风而获得认可。 Yet her portfolio of duties overseeing education, science and technology, health and women’s and children’s affairs — some of which are typically relegated to female politicians — underscored the constraints on that power. 然而，她负责的教育、科技、卫生以及妇女儿童事务——其中部分职责通常被视为女性政界人士的领域——恰恰凸显了这种权力的局限性。 In its announcement of her death, Xinhua eulogized Ms. Liu as “an excellent Party member, a time-tested and loyal communist fighter” and praised her for her work on the Politburo. But her position on that committee — the party’s second-most powerful group — which she joined in 2007, was not evidence of a liberalizing Communist Party, said Minglu Chen, an associate professor at the University of Sydney who studies gender and politics in China. 在宣布她逝世的讣告中，新华社称赞刘延东为“优秀党员，久经考验的忠诚的共产主义战士”，并赞扬了她在政治局的工作。但悉尼大学研究中国性别与政治的副教授陈明璐表示，她于2007年任职于政治局——党内第二大权力机构——并不能证明共产党正在走向自由化。 在韩国平昌举行的2018年冬季奥运会闭幕式上，刘延东与年轻的参赛者们在一起。 “The party leadership has always been a boys’ club,” Ms. Chen said, noting that three of the six women who have reached the Politburo were also charged with overseeing health and women’s and children’s policy, areas that have traditionally been considered softer. Today, there are no women in the Politburo. “党的领导层一直是一个男性俱乐部，”陈明璐说。她指出，曾进入政治局的六名女性中，有三名被安排兼管卫生和妇女儿童政策，这些领域传统上被认为较为软性。如今，政治局中已没有女性。 Ms. Liu was born on Nov. 22, 1945, and grew up in Nantong, a city in the coastal province of Jiangsu. As the daughter of Liu Ruilong, a military commander and former vice minister of agriculture, she was what is known as a princeling, or a descendant of a senior party official. That may have given her a keener sense of political strategy than her peers. But she began to carve a path in politics only after studying engineering at Tsinghua University, and then working in factories for a decade in the 1970s. 刘延东出生于1945年11月22日，在沿海省份江苏省的南通市长大。作为军事指挥官、前农业部副部长刘瑞龙的女儿，她属于所谓的“太子党”，即中共高级官员的后代。这或许使她比同龄人更具政治战略眼光。但直到她在清华大学学习工程学，随后在20世纪70年代在工厂工作十年之后，她才开始在政坛开辟自己的道路。 She took a job in the municipal government in Beijing in 1980 and, not long after, joined the Communist Youth League, a training ground for many of China’s top leaders. It was there that she started to be groomed for a political career, and where she got to know Hu Jintao, who was China’s president from 2003 until 2013. 1980年，她在北京市政府工作，不久之后加入了共青团中央，这是许多中国最高领导人的训练营。正是在那里，她开始为政治生涯接受培养，并结识了2003年至2013年担任中国国家主席的胡锦涛。 It was not until 2002, when Ms. Liu became head of the United Front, which works to make alliances outside the party, that she started amassing broader political influence. China had just joined the World Trade Organization, opening the country to international trade and the global economy. 直到2002年，刘延东出任致力于在党外结成联盟的统战部部长后，她才开始积累更广泛的政治影响力。当时中国刚刚加入世界贸易组织，向国际贸易和全球经济开放。 Her approach to her own work reflected that outward turn. In the United Front, Ms. Liu took her responsibility for building relationships beyond the party seriously. She drew acclaim during a 2006 visit to Mount Sanqing, in Jiangxi Province, when she insisted on climbing the mountain to the summit, beyond the reach of the cable cars, in order to meet with Taoist priests, who said “they had never seen such a high-ranking official before,” according to state media. 她的工作方式反映了这种向外看的转变。在统战部，刘延东认真履行了她在党外建立关系的责任。2006年，她在访问江西省三清山时赢得了赞誉，当时她坚持徒步爬上缆车无法到达的山顶去会见道士，据官方媒体报道，这些道士说他们“从未见过这么大的官”。 The following year, Ms. Liu was promoted to the Politburo, and in 2013 she became a vice premier, among the country’s highest-ranking officials. 次年，刘延东晋升为政治局委员，并于2013年出任国务院副总理，跻身该国最高级别官员之列。 During that period, as trade between China and the United States was booming and their economies were growing more intertwined, Ms. Liu became known for cultivating deeper cultural ties between the two countries. Together with Hillary Clinton, then the secretary of state, she led an initiative in 2010 to deepen the bilateral relationship beyond trade into areas like education and sports. 在此期间，随着中美贸易的蓬勃发展，两国经济日益交织，刘延东因致力于深化两国文化联系而闻名。2010年，她与时任美国国务卿希拉里·克林顿共同领导了一项倡议，旨在将双边关系从贸易深化到教育和体育等领域。 During her visit to Beijing to announce the program, known as the China-U.S. High Level Consultation on People-to-People Exchange, Mrs. Clinton quipped, “I think Madam Liu and I are going to revive the ping pong diplomacy.” She was referring to the visit of American table tennis players to China in 1971 that helped pave the way for the two countries to restore relations after years of Cold War tensions. 在希拉里·克林顿访问北京，宣布这一被称为“中美人文交流高层磋商”的项目时，她打趣说：“我想刘女士和我将重振乒乓外交。”她指的是1971年美国乒乓球运动员访华一事，这为两国在多年的冷战紧张局势后恢复关系铺平了道路。 2010年，刘延东在北京与时任国务卿希拉里·克林顿合影。 Ms. Liu later gave Mrs. Clinton a photograph of her father, telling her that he had rescued American pilots during World War II. Mrs. Clinton said she would hang it in her office. 刘延东后来送给希拉里·克林顿一张自己父亲的照片，并告诉她，她父亲在二战期间曾营救过美国飞行员。希拉里说她会把照片挂在自己的办公室里。 Ms. Liu also oversaw planning for the 2008 Olympic Games in Beijing, and under China’s current leader, Xi Jinping, helped support the development of computer chips, semiconductor manufacturing equipment and high-end manufacturing, helping to lay the foundation for China’s increasingly dominant position in areas like electric vehicles. She also worked to lower the steep cost of drugs and oversaw reforms of public hospitals. 刘延东还曾主管2008年北京奥运会的筹备工作，并在中国现任领导人习近平的领导下，协助支持了计算机芯片、半导体制造设备和高端制造业的发展，帮助中国在电动汽车等领域日益占据主导地位奠定基础。她还致力于降低高昂的药品成本，并主管了公立医院改革。 She had the leadership style of “a cautious, dependable administrator operating within a strongly hierarchical system,” said Fubing Su, a professor of political science at Vassar College. “She projected steadiness rather than charisma, rarely asserting a distinctive personal identity or an agenda of her own,” he added. 瓦萨学院政治学教授苏福兵表示，她的领导风格是“在等级森严的体制内运作的谨慎可靠管理者”。他还说：“她展现出的是稳健而非个人魅力，很少彰显鲜明的个人色彩或提出自己的议程。” To climb the ranks of the Communist Party, officials must demonstrate that they can strengthen the economy in cities and provinces under their purview. Women, however, are almost never given those jobs, said Dali Yang, a professor of political science at the University of Chicago. 为了在共产党内晋升，官员们必须证明他们能够巩固其管辖下省市的经济。然而，芝加哥大学政治学教授杨大利指出，女性几乎从未被委以这类重任。 Despite those limits, Ms. Liu made significant strides. But a woman has never been on the Standing Committee, the highest decision-making body in China. 尽管存在这些限制，刘延东还是取得了重大成就。但是，至今从未有女性进入过中国最高决策机构——政治局常务委员会。 “If she had been a man,” said Professor Yang, “she would most likely have made it to the Politburo Standing Committee.” “如果她是男性，”杨大利说，“她极有可能进入政治局常委会。” Murphy Zhao对本文有研究贡献。 艾莎(Alexandra Stevenson)是《纽约时报》记者，主要报道中国经济及其在全球的影响。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

Together with Hillary Clinton, then the secretary of state, she led an initiative in 2010 to deepen the bilateral relationship beyond trade into areas like education and sports. 在此期间，随着中美贸易的蓬勃发展，两国经济日益交织，刘延东因致力于深化两国文化联系而闻名。2010年，她与时任美国国务卿希拉里·克林顿共同领导了一项倡议，旨在将双边关系从贸易深化到教育和体育等领域。 During her visit to Beijing to announce the program, known as the China-U.S. High Level Consultation on People-to-People Exchange, Mrs. Clinton quipped, “I think Madam Liu and I are going to revive the ping pong diplomacy.” She was referring to the visit of American table tennis players to China in 1971 that helped pave the way for the two countries to restore relations after years of Cold War tensions. 在 希拉里·克林顿 访问北京，宣布这一被称为“中美人文交流高层磋商”的项目时，她打趣说：“我想刘女士和我将重振乒乓外交。”她指的是1971年美国乒乓球运动员访华一事，这为两国在多年的冷战紧张局势后恢复关系铺平了道路。 2010年，刘延东在北京与时任国务卿希拉里·克林顿合影。 Ms. Liu later gave Mrs. Clinton a photograph of her father, telling her that he had rescued American pilots during World War II. Mrs. Clinton said she would hang it in her office. 刘延东后来送给希拉里·克林顿一张自己父亲的照片，并告诉她，她父亲在二战期间曾营救过美国飞行员。希拉里说她会把照片挂在自己的办公室里。 Ms. Liu also oversaw planning for the 2008 Olympic Games in Beijing, and under China’s current leader, Xi Jinping, helped support the development of computer chips, semiconductor manufacturing equipment and high-end manufacturing, helping to lay the foundation for China’s increasingly dominant position in areas like electric vehicles. She also worked to lower the steep cost of drugs and oversaw reforms of public hospitals. 刘延东还曾主管2008年北京奥运会的筹备工作，并在中国现任领导人习近平的领导下，协助支持了计算机芯片、半导体制造设备和高端制造业的发展，帮助中国在电动汽车等领域日益占据主导地位奠定基础。她还致力于降低高昂的药品成本，并主管了公立医院改革。 She had the leadership style of “a cautious, dependable administrator operating within a strongly hierarchical system,” said Fubing Su, a professor of political science at Vassar College. “She projected steadiness rather than charisma, rarely asserting a distinctive personal identity or an agenda of her own,” he added. 瓦萨学院政治学教授苏福兵表示，她的领导风格是“在等级森严的体制内运作的谨慎可靠管理者”。他还说：“她展现出的是稳健而非个人魅力，很少彰显鲜明的个人色彩或提出自己的议程。” To climb the ranks of the Communist Party, officials must demonstrate that they can strengthen the economy in cities and provinces under their purview. Women, however, are almost never given those jobs, said Dali Yang, a professor of political science at the University of Chicago. 为了在共产党内晋升，官员们必须证明他们能够巩固其管辖下省市的经济。然而，芝加哥大学政治学教授杨大利指出，女性几乎从未被委以这类重任。 Despite those limits, Ms. Liu made significant strides. But a woman has never been on the Standing Committee, the highest decision-making body in China. 尽管存在这些限制，刘延东还是取得了重大成就。但是，至今从未有女性进入过中国最高决策机构——政治局常务委员会。 “If she had been a man,” said Professor Yang, “she would most likely have made it to the Politburo Standing Committee.” “如果她是男性，”杨大利说，“她极有可能进入政治局常委会。” Murphy Zhao对本文有研究贡献。 艾莎(Alexandra Stevenson) 是《纽约时报》记者，主要报道中国经济及其在全球的影响。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: 日剧《Vivant》被指“辱华”，三丽鸥取消联名合作
items.description: 赫海威, HISAKO UENO2026年11月2日北京方面称，热门日本剧集《别班》宣扬对华负面看法。 Andy Wong/Associated Press China’s recent pressure campaign against Japan has involved critical minerals, tourism, seafood and even pandas. Now Beijing is taking the dispute to the cultural sphere, targeting a Japanese television drama. 中国近期对日本施压的领域涵盖关键矿产、旅游、海鲜乃至大熊猫。如今北京将争端延伸至文化领域，瞄准了一部日本电视剧。 The Chinese government has in recent days focused its ire on “Vivant,” one of Japan’s most popular shows, a cross between “24” and “Homeland” that tells the story of Japanese spies working to protect their country from threats overseas. 中国政府近日将矛头对准《别班》(Vivant)。这部日本最受欢迎的剧集之一风格介于《24小时》与《国土安全》之间，讲述日本间谍在海外行动以保卫国家免受威胁的故事。 Beijing says the show, which features a fictional Chinese intelligence agency called “Xinxi” as the antagonist, promotes negative views of China. The second season of “Vivant,” which premiered in July, includes scenes of Chinese agents torturing Japanese operatives. In the first season, the enemy state was not identified. 北京方面称，该剧将虚构的中国情报机构“信息”(Xinxi)设为反派，宣扬对华负面看法。今年7月首播的《别班》第二季包含中国特工酷刑折磨日本特工的场景。第一季中，敌对国家并未具名。 “This television series once again reveals that there is a force in Japan that attempts to use cultural products to smear China and spread anti-China sentiment,” a spokesman for China’s Foreign Ministry, Guo Jiakun, said at a news conference in Beijing on Thursday. “这部电视剧再次暴露出日本国内始终存在一股势力，企图通过文化产品抹黑中国、散播仇华情绪，”中国外交部发言人郭嘉昆周四在北京的记者会上表示。 China’s criticism of “Vivant” comes amid a broader effort to penalize Japan for comments made last year by Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi. She suggested that Japan could intervene militarily if China were to attack Taiwan, a self-governed democracy that Beijing claims is part of its territory. 中国对《别班》的批评是惩罚日本的整体行动的一部分，起因是日本首相高市早苗去年的言论。她曾暗示，若中国攻击台湾（北京声称该自治民主政体是其领土一部分），日本可能军事介入。 The outcry over “Vivant” began on Sunday, when China Central Television, the state broadcaster, condemned the series in a social media post. 对《别班》的声讨始于上周日，国家广播机构中央电视台在社交媒体发帖谴责该剧。 The criticism grew so intense that Sanrio, the Japanese entertainment juggernaut behind Hello Kitty, announced on Thursday that it was canceling a merchandise partnership with the show. China is one of Sanrio’s fastest-growing markets; the company generated about $200 million in revenue there in the fiscal year that ended in March, almost double the previous year. 批评声浪愈演愈烈，以至于Hello Kitty背后的日本娱乐巨头三丽鸥于周四宣布取消与该剧的商品联名合作。中国是三丽鸥增长最快的市场之一；在截至3月的财年中，该公司在华营收约2亿美元，几乎是前一年的两倍。 The company said in a statement that it had determined that “certain content associated with this collaboration does not align with Sanrio’s corporate philosophy.” 三丽鸥在声明中称，已认定“关于本次联名相关内容，我们认为其中包含与三丽鸥集团企业理念不符的表达”。 “Vivant,” which premiered in 2023, focuses on a fictional intelligence operation called “Beppan” that is affiliated with Japan’s military. 《别班》于2023年首播，聚焦一个隶属日本军方的虚构情报行动“别班”。 The show’s creators have said they did not intend for it to fuel geopolitical tensions. TBS, the network that airs the series, said in a statement that “Vivant” is “completely fictional.” 剧集创作者表示无意借此加剧地缘政治紧张。播出方TBS电视台在声明中称《别班》系“完全虚构”。 “The main premise is that it does not degrade any particular country,” Masamine Ryuho, the network’s president, said at a news conference on Wednesday. “该剧的基本前提是不贬低任何特定国家，”TBS社长龙宝正峰周三在记者会上表示。 China responded furiously to Ms. Takaichi’s comments about Taiwan last year, accusing her of crossing a “red line” and demanding a retraction. Since then, Beijing has reduced the export of rare earths to Japan; urged millions of tourists to avoid the country; and increased military patrols in the seas near Japan. China has also shown a growing preoccupation with efforts by Ms. Takaichi to rebuild the military, accusing Japan of reviving World War II-era militarism. 中国去年对高市早苗涉台言论反应激烈，指责其越过“红线”并要求撤回。此后，北京减少对日稀土出口，敦促数百万游客避免赴日，并增加日本附近海域的军事巡逻。中国还对高市早苗重建军力的举措表现出日益关切，指责日本复活二战时期的军国主义。 Ms. Takaichi, an outspoken critic of China, has expressed support for “Vivant.” Earlier this month, before China stepped up its propaganda efforts, she said during an appearance before Parliament that she records the show religiously and hopes to binge watch the second season over the New Year holiday. 高市早苗直言批评中国，她对《别班》表示支持。本月早些时候，在中国加大宣传攻势之前，她在国会答辩时称自己每集必录，希望新年假期一口气看完第二季。 China has long sought to control how it is portrayed in films and on television produced overseas. The criticism of “Vivant” serves an important propaganda aim for the ruling Communist Party, analysts said: trying to highlight Japan’s record of atrocities during World War II. 中国长期寻求管控海外影视作品中对自身的呈现。分析人士称，对《别班》的批评服务于执政的共产党的重要宣传目的：试图凸显日本在二战期间犯下的暴行。 The People’s Daily, the Chinese Communist Party’s mouthpiece, wrote on Thursday that the series accused China of employing “torture methods used by the Japanese army during its invasion of China” in the run-up to World War II. 中共机关报《人民日报》周四写道，该剧将二战前夕侵华日军“曾经实施的切指、刺腹等暴行”安在中国头上。 William Chou, a Japan expert and senior fellow at the Hudson Institute, a think tank in Washington, said that “Vivant” was an appealing target for China because of its popularity, and because Beijing felt it could help feed a propaganda narrative. 华盛顿智库哈德逊研究所日本问题专家、高级研究员威廉·周表示，《别班》因其热度成了中国的一个有吸引力的目标，同时也因为北京认为它有助于投喂宣传叙事。 “The Chinese are hunting for excuses,” he said. “They’re creating reasons to fuel this outrage, this cognitive warfare.” “中国人在找借口，”他说。“他们在制造理由来煽动这种愤怒、这场认知战。” 赫海威(Javier C. Hernández)是《纽约时报》东京分社社长，领导时报对日本及周边地区的报道。在过去十年的大部分时间里，他一直在亚洲进行报道，此前曾任驻华记者。 Hisako Ueno是常驻东京的记者/研究员，撰写日本政治、商业、劳工、性别及文化相关议题。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: “激光灭蚊防空系统”：中国企业推出人工智能灭蚊设备
items.description: KEITH BRADSHER2026年11月2日 For anyone kept awake by the infernal whine of mosquitoes, artificial intelligence may be coming to the rescue — armed with a laser. 对于那些被蚊子该死的嗡嗡声折磨得夜不能寐的人来说，人工智能可能正携激光赶来相救。 A Chinese company has started marketing a $1,000 A.I.-enabled device that tracks mosquitoes in flight and burns their wings off. It uses technology found in self-driving cars to pinpoint its targets, while relying on A.I. to decide when it is safe to fire. 一家中国公司已开始推销一款售价1000美元、搭载人工智能的设备。它能够追踪飞行中的蚊子，并用激光烧掉它们的翅膀。该设备利用自动驾驶汽车所采用的技术精确锁定目标，同时依靠人工智能判断何时可以安全发射激光。 During a recent demonstration at the offices of Photon Matrix, the company behind the device, it appeared remarkably effective. The white, nearly brick-size machine quickly zapped mosquito after mosquito, each bursting into a green or blue flame with a tiny pop. 最近，在这款设备的研发公司光之矩智能科技有限公司的办公室举行的一场演示中，它展现出了惊人的灭蚊效果。这台大小接近一块砖头的白色机器迅速将一只又一只蚊子击落。每只蚊子被击中时，都会伴随着轻微的爆裂声，迸出绿色或蓝色的火光。 For anyone who has ever wished mosquitoes a horrible death, this is a strikingly high-tech way to make that wish a reality. The laser delivers a gruesome end, though not a quick one. Mosquitoes whose wings have burned off can take hours or even days to die, lying on the ground and twitching slightly, said Wang Chuan, chief executive and founder of Photon Matrix, based in Changzhou, about 100 miles northwest of Shanghai. 对于任何希望蚊子不得好死的人来说，这种高科技手段无疑能让他们如愿以偿。激光确实能让蚊子死得很惨，却无法让它们迅速毙命。光之矩的首席执行官、创始人王川说，翅膀被烧掉的蚊子会躺在地上，身体微微抽搐，要过数小时甚至数天才会死亡。该公司位于上海西北约160公里的常州。 After the demonstration, I examined the fallen mosquitoes. The wings appeared to be gone, but their legs and bodies looked intact. None could fly, even when I waved my hand directly over them. 演示结束后，我仔细查看了掉落在地上的蚊子。它们的翅膀似乎已经没有了，但腿和身体看起来完好无损。即使我把手伸到它们正上方挥动，也没有一只蚊子能飞起来。 常州光之矩智能科技有限公司的一间测试室内，一只失去飞行能力的蚊子落在地上。这款激光灭蚊设备的近照。激光从设备上较大的矩形玻璃窗口射出。光之矩公司的技术人员正在放蚊子，以测试设备性能。 But there is a potentially dangerous catch. A laser powerful enough to disable a mosquito can also damage the human eye. 但存在一个潜在的危险隐患。强大到足以让蚊子失去行动能力的激光，同样可能伤害人眼。 The device, the Laser Mosquito Air Defense System, uses a Class 4 laser, the most powerful classification, typically reserved for industrial applications. Such lasers can cause retinal injuries in less than a second, and their sale and use are tightly regulated. 该设备名为激光灭蚊防空系统，使用4类激光——最高功率等级，通常用于工业应用。这类激光可在不到一秒内造成视网膜损伤，其销售和使用受到严格监管。 While the United States leads in developing the most advanced A.I. models, the device shows how quickly China is embedding powerful computing in consumer products. The technology also has military potential. It’s not hard to imagine how a system that tracks and shoots down mosquitoes today could be adapted to target drones tomorrow. 尽管美国在开发最先进的人工智能模型方面处于领先地位，但这款设备表明，中国正以多么快的速度将强大的计算能力融入消费产品。这项技术也具有军事应用潜力。不难想像，一套如今能够追踪并击落蚊子的系统，未来也可能经过改造，用于瞄准无人机。 Mr. Wang said that the company was seeking regulatory approval in China, Europe and the United States and that he believed Chinese approval was close. 王川表示，公司正在中国、欧洲和美国申请监管批准，他相信很快就能获得中国监管部门的批准。 In the United States, manufacturers can begin selling new laser devices after submitting paperwork to the Food and Drug Administration, which does not test the products, said Ken Barat, a former laser safety officer at Lawrence Berkeley National Laboratory who oversaw the drafting of the world’s technical standards for research lasers. 曾担任劳伦斯伯克利国家实验室激光安全官、负责主持起草全球科研用激光技术标准的肯·巴拉特说，在美国，制造商向食品药品监督管理局(FDA)提交文件后就可以开始销售新的激光设备，而FDA并不检测产品。 蚊子从网箱中飞出时，被设备发射的蓝色激光击中。 Mr. Barat said Photon Matrix’s multiple safeguards could make the device safe. But he cautioned that a Class 4 laser designed to focus on something as tiny as a mosquito could pack “a lot of energy” into a small space. 巴拉特说，光之矩的多重安全防护措施可能使这款设备达到安全使用的要求。但他同时警告说，专门用于瞄准蚊子这样微小目标的4类激光可能会将“大量能量”集中在一个极小的区域。 Photon Matrix initially tested less powerful Class 3 lasers but found they could not reliably disable mosquitoes, Mr. Wang said. The company chose a Class 4 laser, limiting each burst to one-hundredth of a second — long enough, he said, to burn off the wings while reducing, but not eliminating, the risk of eye damage. The wings, which have little ability to absorb heat, burn off before the mosquito’s body is heavily affected. 王川说，光之矩最初测试了功率较低的3类激光，但发现它们无法可靠地使蚊子失去行动能力。公司选择了4类激光，并将每次发射的持续时间限制在百分之一秒。他说，这个时长足以烧掉蚊子的翅膀，同时降低眼部受伤的风险，但无法完全消除风险。翅膀吸收热量的能力很弱，在身体受到严重影响之前，翅膀就已被烧毁。 To protect people and pets, an A.I.-enabled camera recognizes them and prevents the laser from firing. The system also identifies reflective surfaces that could send beams bouncing in unpredictable directions. An infrared system provides illumination so the camera can operate at night. A separate radar system detects movement by people or pets in the laser’s path, even in total darkness. 为了保护人和宠物，设备配备了一台搭载人工智能的摄像头，能够识别他们，并阻止激光发射。系统还能识别反光表面，以免激光束反射后射向难以预测的方向。红外系统提供照明，使摄像头能够在夜间工作。此外，一套独立的雷达系统能够探测激光路径上人员或宠物的活动，即使在完全黑暗的环境中也能发挥作用。 Buyers must also pass a 15-question safety test, including questions like which room is least suitable for the device. (The answer: a bathroom, with high humidity, confined space and reflective surfaces.) Only those who answer every question correctly can register a fingerprint to activate the machine. 购买者还必须通过一项包含15道题目的安全测试，其中一道题要求选出最不适合使用该设备的房间。（正确答案是浴室，因为那里湿度高、空间狭小，而且存在反光表面。）只有全部答对的人才能登记指纹，激活机器。 在激光发射校准台上，一只蚊子被固定在一根细金属丝的末端。一面用于旋转并反射设备所发射激光的镜子。网箱中用于测试激光设备的蚊子。 The mosquito hunting relies on lidar — an acronym for light detection and ranging, a technology widely used in self-driving cars. The device fires 100,000 extremely faint laser pulses a second to map an area in a flat, two-dimensional plane in front of it, tracking moving objects smaller than a pea as they cross that plane. 灭蚊依赖激光雷达(lidar)，即“光探测与测距”(light detection and ranging)技术，它广泛应用于自动驾驶汽车。该设备每秒发射10万次极其微弱的激光脉冲，对前方一个平面的二维区域进行扫描测绘，并追踪穿过该平面、体积比豌豆还小的移动物体。 The idea of shooting mosquitoes out of the air with lasers predates the current A.I. boom. In 2010, Intellectual Ventures, a company founded by a former chief technology officer at Microsoft, unveiled a similar anti-mosquito system but never mass-produced it. 用激光在空中击落蚊子的想法早在当前这波人工智能热潮兴起之前就已出现。2010年，由微软前首席技术官创办的公司Intellectual Ventures曾发布过一套类似的激光灭蚊系统，但从未量产。 Photon Matrix said it had received 5,000 prepaid orders for the device and had secured a contract manufacturer, with mass production expected to begin within weeks. 光之矩表示，已收到5000份预付订单，并已确定一家合同制造商，预计几周内开始量产。 Mr. Wang is already planning a next-generation device that would fire even shorter bursts. With a future model, he hopes, the eye’s moisture will absorb the laser energy before it reaches the retina. 王川已经开始规划下一代设备，届时激光脉冲的持续时间将进一步缩短。他希望，未来的型号能够让人眼中的水分在激光能量抵达视网膜之前就将其吸收。 Siyi Zhao对本文有研究贡献。 Keith Bradsher是《纽约时报》北京分社社长，此前曾任上海分社社长、香港分社社长、底特律分社社长，以及华盛顿记者。他在新冠疫情期间常驻中国进行报道。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: 玻璃摩天大楼：壮丽的城市天际线有多“热”？
items.description: CHICO HARLAN, ZUNAIRA SAIEED2026年10月30日 Ulet Ifansasti for The New York Times One thousand feet above city traffic, from her new 74th-floor apartment, Anastasia Zeeman has the kind of enchanting views that only floor-to-ceiling glass can offer. She looks out on a skyline and horizon where storms and sunsets play out like big-screen movies. 城市车流上方约300米处，阿纳斯塔西娅·齐曼在她位于74层的新公寓里欣赏着只有落地玻璃才能提供的迷人景色。她眺望天际线和地平线，风暴与日落交织的景象宛如大银幕电影般上演。 But Malaysia’s tropical sun sometimes delivers what Ms. Zeeman calls a “wall of heat” radiating from her windows. 但马来西亚的热带阳光有时会带来齐曼所说的“热墙”，从她的窗户辐射进来。 More than any other form of architecture, glass skyscrapers testify to the human desire for sweeping views and a sense of rising above the fray. In some of the world’s fastest developing places — Dubai, Mumbai, Jakarta, Kuala Lumpur — they have become city-defining showpieces, signaling sophistication and rising financial clout. 与其他任何建筑形式相比，玻璃摩天大楼最能体现人类对开阔视野的向往，以及凌驾于尘嚣之上的追求。在迪拜、孟买、雅加达、吉隆坡等全球发展最迅速的城市中，它们已成为定义城市风貌的标志性建筑，象征着精致和日益增强的金融影响力。 And yet glass tends to be ill-suited for keeping out the heat, and its overuse often makes buildings more energy intensive to cool. That’s fueling a debate about whether these symbols of modernity make sense in a world growing hotter because of climate change. 然而，玻璃往往不适合阻隔热量，其过度使用常常使建筑冷却所需能耗更高。这引发了一场辩论：在因气候变化而日益炎热的世界里，这些现代性的象征是否还有意义。 Some argue that the ambition and innovation that spawned the high-rise era can help modern skyscrapers fend off rising temperatures while maintaining the million-dollar views. Others say the all-glass aesthetic is at odds with the environmental goal of reducing greenhouse-gas emissions. They say it is time to rethink city skylines. 一些人认为，凭借催生摩天大楼时代的雄心和创新，现代摩天大楼能够在保持价值百万美元的壮丽景观同时抵御气温上升。另一些人说，全玻璃美学与减少温室气体排放的环境目标相悖。他们说，是时候对城市天际线进行重新思考了。 When he was New York City mayor in 2019, Bill de Blasio briefly floated the idea of banning the “glass and steel” structures altogether. Philip Oldfield, an Australian architecture scholar who wrote a book on sustainable high rises, calls the glass towers “environmentally criminal.” Ken Shuttleworth, a prominent British architect who three decades ago helped design London’s Gherkin building, now says he’d do it differently, without quite as much glass all the way around. 2019年担任纽约市长时，比尔·德布拉西奥曾短暂提出全面禁止“玻璃和钢铁”结构的想法。写过一本关于可持续高层建筑书籍的澳大利亚建筑学者菲利普·奥德菲尔德称，玻璃摩天楼“在环境上是犯罪”。30年前曾参与设计伦敦“小黄瓜”大楼的英国著名建筑师肯·沙特尔斯沃思表示，现在他会采用不同方案，不会四周都使用那么多玻璃。 “You really just need to have smaller windows,” said Mr. Shuttleworth. He said his approach to skyscraper design has changed as he’s come to realize that “we are burning a hole in the planet.” “你其实只需要把窗户做小一些，”沙特尔斯沃思说。他说，随着他逐渐意识到“我们正在把地球烧出一个洞”，他对摩天大楼设计的思路已经改变。 穿透科威特的浓雾。伦敦著名“小黄瓜”大楼的建筑师之一表示，如果今天重新设计，他会减少玻璃的使用量。 Despite that criticism, the glass skyscraper’s appeal endures. 尽管有这些批评，玻璃摩天大楼的魅力依然不减。 The form, which originated in American cities like Chicago and New York, has now spread across China, the Middle East and Southeast Asia. Over the past decade, the world has constructed 25 times the number of buildings 200 meters (roughly 655 feet) or taller that it did in the 1980s, according to the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat. Some 91 percent of the world’s skyscrapers of that height have been built since the turn of the 21st century. 这种形式起源于芝加哥和纽约等美国城市，如今已传播到中国、中东和东南亚。根据高层建筑与城市人居委员会的数据，过去十年，全球建造的200米或更高建筑数量是1980年代的25倍。世界上约91%的这一高度摩天大楼是在进入21世纪以来建造的。 The “vast majority” have facades largely of glass, said Antony Wood, who was the president of that council until last year. 该委员会任期至去年的前主席安东尼·伍德说，“绝大多数”建筑的外立面主要是玻璃。 Proponents of glass-dominant design say this building spree can still be responsible if strategic choices are made. 支持玻璃为主设计方案的人士认为，只要做出战略选择，这种建筑热潮仍然可以做到环保。 Because the sun doesn’t hit a building equally from all directions, buildings can boost their energy efficiency simply with the right orientation. Architects can also add features like fins or undulations so less sunlight directly hits the glass. Stringing greenery on glass facades is also a trend. 因为太阳并非从所有方向均匀照射建筑，建筑只需通过合理的朝向设计，就能提高能源效率。建筑师还可以添加翅片或起伏等特征，减少阳光直射玻璃。在玻璃外立面上布置绿植也是一种趋势。 Glass can also be treated with gossamer-thin metallic coatings that reflect away radiation. Most buildings use several layers of glass to impede the heat. One high-end option involves sandwiching automated blinds between them. 玻璃还可以涂覆薄如蛛丝的金属涂层，以反射辐射热。大多数建筑使用多层玻璃来阻挡热量。一种高端选择是在玻璃之间夹入自动百叶窗。 “It’s not as simple as people think it is,” said Gordon Gill, an architect at Adrian Smith + Gordon Gill. He has helped design numerous skyscrapers, including a 1,000-meter tower in Saudi Arabia that will be the world’s tallest once completed. “I’m not a big fan of, ‘Aha, we found the answer: We’re just going to use less glass.’ I don’t believe in panaceas. Your entire process is about balance.” “这并不像人们想的那么简单，”阿德里安·史密斯+戈登·吉尔建筑事务所的建筑师戈登·吉尔说。他帮助设计了众多摩天大楼，包括沙特阿拉伯一座1000米高的塔楼，建成后将成为世界最高建筑。“我不太赞同那种‘啊哈，我们找到答案了：少用点玻璃就行’的想法。我不相信万灵药。你的整个过程都关乎平衡。” Most studies conclude that cutting down on glazing, as glass is sometimes called, does help reduce energy for cooling. A 2019 analysis of 1,000 American office buildings found that structures with larger window ratios had higher air-conditioning loads — though window size didn’t predict a building’s overall energy use. A research paper from Saudi Arabia concluded that glazing “should be minimized in hot regions,” with windows ideally amounting to 20 to 30 percent of the facade. 大多数研究得出结论，减少玻璃确实有助于降低冷却能耗。2019年对1000栋美国办公楼的分析发现，窗户比例越大的建筑，空调负荷越高——尽管窗户大小并不能预测建筑的整体能耗。沙特阿拉伯的一篇研究论文得出结论，在炎热地区“应尽量减少”玻璃的使用，理想情况下，窗户应占外立面的20%到30%。 But skyscrapers, of course, are so much more than objects meant to maximize efficiency. Big windows let in natural light, which limits the need for artificial lighting. 但摩天大楼当然不仅仅是为了最大限度提高能效而存在的。大窗户能引入自然光，从而减少对人工照明的需求。 They also help units sell. 它们也有助于房屋销售。 “默德卡118”是世界第二高的摩天大楼，为吉隆坡的天际线增添了一抹亮色。阿纳斯塔西娅·齐曼站在Oxley大楼的泳池旁，该建筑采用落地玻璃设计。 Ms. Zeeman, for example, had looked at seven or eight properties before walking into Oxley Towers, one of which is Kuala Lumpur’s sixth-tallest building. She’d moved from the Dutch countryside with her husband, who’d gotten an engineering job in the city. They saw the panorama and paid over their budget. 例如，齐曼女士在走进豪利大厦之前看过七八处房产，其中一栋是吉隆坡第六高的建筑。她和丈夫从荷兰乡村搬来，丈夫在这座城市找到了一份工程工作。他们看到全景后，以超出预算的价格买下了房子。 “To wake up with this view, it’s a completely different mood,” she said. “It inspires me to do more.” “每天清晨醒来就能看到这样的景色，心情完全不一样，”她说。“它激励我做更多事情。” ‘Beautiful to the eye’ “赏心悦目” Glass has helped give Malaysia the very thing its prime minister said he wanted three decades ago: buildings that evoke development and are “beautiful to the eye.” 玻璃帮助马来西亚实现了其总理30年前期盼的目标：既象征着发展又“赏心悦目”的建筑。 The country started in 1996 by completing the twin Petronas Towers, the tallest buildings in the world at the time. Then it kept going, constructing hundreds more skyscrapers — including two taller than Petronas. Malaysia, with just 35 million people, now has more buildings 200 meters or higher than any country but China, the United States and the United Arab Emirates. 马来西亚于1996年建成了双子塔，当时它们是世界最高建筑。从那以后，它继续建造了数百座摩天大楼，其中包括两座比双子塔更高的建筑。马来西亚只有3500万人口，如今其200米及以上高层建筑数量仅次于中国、美国和阿联酋，位居世界第四。 Some of them, particularly ones with top-end technology, have good energy efficiency numbers, said Sarly Adre Sarkum, an architect and the chief executive of Malaysia’s Green Building Index. But Mr. Sarkum said the overall quality of the towers is “still not so good.” He said that in Malaysia’s climate, extensive glass facades carry “significant energy consequences.” 其中一些建筑，尤其是采用尖端技术的建筑，能源效率指标相当不错，马来西亚绿色建筑指数首席执行官、建筑师萨利·阿德雷·萨尔库姆说。但他指出，这些高楼的整体质量“仍然不太理想”。在马来西亚的气候条件下，大面积使用玻璃幕墙会带来“显著的能源消耗问题”。 马来西亚绿色建筑指数首席执行官萨莉·阿德雷·萨库姆。吉隆坡的新建项目。 Roughly 60 percent of the building energy use in Malaysia stems from air-conditioning, Mr. Sarkum said. “When buyers purchase these, they think they get great views,” Mr. Sarkum said. “But you need to keep the curtains closed.” 萨尔库姆说，马来西亚约60%的建筑能耗来自空调。“买房的人觉得，这样可以欣赏到绝佳的风景，”他说。“但实际上，你得一直拉着窗帘。” The Oxley Towers, where Ms. Zeeman lives, represents one of the city’s heaviest uses of glass. Even the bathrooms next to the gym have floor-to-ceiling windows. 齐曼女士居住的奥克斯利大厦是这座城市玻璃使用量最大的建筑之一。甚至健身房旁边的卫生间也有落地窗。 The Oxley was designed by a firm founded by David Mizan Hashim, a self-described “idealist” who obtained his master’s degree from Harvard in 1986 and launched his company, Veritas, soon after. Veritas says it accepts only projects that aim for green certifications. 奥克斯利大厦由戴维·米赞·哈希姆创立的公司设计。哈希姆自称“理想主义者”，1986年在哈佛获得硕士学位，不久后创立了Veritas。该公司表示，只承接以获得绿色建筑认证为目标的项目。 But Dr. Hashim acknowledged that his idealism doesn’t always play out, given the trade-offs over aesthetics and performance. “This is the struggle of my life,” he said. 但哈希姆承认，考虑到建筑美观与性能之间需要作出取舍，他的理想主义并不总能付诸实践。“这是我一生都在应对的难题，”他说。 林立的玻璃摩天大楼是吉隆坡彰显现代感的一个方面。戴维·米赞·哈希姆（中）表示，在追求高效建筑与满足商业期望之间取得平衡“是我一生都在应对的难题”。 For one thing, developers of residential high rises don’t wind up paying the energy bills. “So there is less of an incentive for them to go all-out,” Dr. Hashim said. 其中一个问题是，住宅高楼的开发商最终并不需要支付能源账单。“因此，他们缺乏全力提高能效的动力，”哈希姆说。 The Singapore-based company that developed Oxley said in a sustainability report that it works “continuously” to improve the efficiency of its properties, and uses energy-efficient air-conditioning systems and motion-sensor lighting where possible. It says Oxley Towers have “high-quality glazing” that “reduces the need for extensive air-conditioning.” 开发奥克斯利大厦的新加坡公司在一份可持续发展报告中表示，公司“持续”致力于提高旗下物业的能源效率，并在条件允许的情况下使用节能空调系统和感应式照明。公司称，奥克斯利大厦采用了“高品质玻璃”，能够“减少对大量使用空调的需求”。 Even so, Dr. Hashim said, the building is “not as cutting-edge as it could be.” That’s because the development company wanted a relatively unadorned look, which removed the possibility of adding shading features. “That was an aesthetic choice,” Dr. Hashim said. 即便如此，哈希姆说，这栋建筑“没有达到它本可以有的前沿水平”。这是因为开发单位想要相对朴素的外观，因此无法增设遮阳设施。“那是出于美观作出的选择，”哈希姆说。 The development company, Oxley Holdings Limited, did not respond to a request for comment. 开发公司豪利控股没有回应置评请求。 The towers will likely obtain a silver rating from Malaysia’s rating index, the third-highest level, he said, though Dr. Hashim had hoped it could be gold. Ultimately, he said, “it is a building that is being sold.” 哈希姆说，这几栋大楼很可能获得马来西亚绿色建筑评级体系的银级认证，这是该体系的第三高等级，尽管他原本希望能达到金级。归根结底，他说，“这是一栋要拿来卖的楼”。 The power of air-conditioning 空调如何改变一切 The glass skyscraper became viable only with the advent of air-conditioning. 直到空调问世，玻璃摩天大楼才成为可能。 Before then, high rises were built primarily out of heavy masonry, with windows as little cutouts. That aesthetic now looks old-fashioned. But in a 2023 study comparing the energy efficiency of nine New York City high rises, the oldest skyscraper — the Chrysler Building, constructed in 1929 — was by far the best performer. 在那之前，高层建筑主要用厚重的砖石建造，窗户只是墙面上一个个小小的开口。这种建筑风格如今看起来已经过时。然而，2023年的一项研究比较了纽约市九栋高层建筑的能源效率，结果发现，其中历史最悠久的摩天大楼——建于1929年的克莱斯勒大厦——能效表现遥遥领先。 Even in Malaysia, the first modestly tall buildings looked as if they were in an almost defensive stance against the sun. 即使在马来西亚，最早的那些不算太高的高层建筑看起来也几乎像是在对太阳严防死守。 The 18-story parliament building of the 1960s, Malaysia’s tallest at the time, came wrapped in a honeycomb-like lattice. The Dayabumi Complex, built in the 1980s, had its windows shrouded behind an ornate white veil inspired by Islamic motifs. 1960年代的18层国会大厦是当时马来西亚最高的建筑，外面包裹着蜂窝状格栅。1980年代建成的达雅布米综合体，其窗户隐藏在受伊斯兰图案启发的华丽白色遮挡物后面。 Stellios Plainiotis, the chief executive of a facade consulting company in Kuala Lumpur, said Malaysia was “effectively experimenting with what a skyscraper for the tropics should look like.” Some of those ideas now feel “remarkably current,” he said. 吉隆坡一家外立面咨询公司首席执行官斯特利奥斯·普莱尼奥蒂斯说，马来西亚“实际上一直在试验热带摩天大楼应该是什么样子”。他说，其中一些想法现在感觉“非常入时”。 Critics of the all-glass approach say air-conditioning excused architects to ignore other design lessons about contending with heat. Those include techniques honed over centuries in warm environments, such as the white, sun-reflective facades of Greece or the open, traditional homes of Southeast Asia. 全玻璃的批评者说，空调让建筑师有借口忽视其他应对高温的设计经验。这些经验包括数百年在炎热环境中磨练出来的技术，比如希腊白色的反光外立面，或东南亚的开放式传统住宅。 马来西亚的200米及以上高层建筑数量仅次于中国、美国和阿联酋，位居世界第四。今年夏天的大多数日子里，马来西亚首都的室外气温都超过了32摄氏度。 “Our ancestors, they didn’t go to school. And yet they could build buildings that respond to the climate,” said Abdul Razak Bin Sapian, a professor of architecture at the International Islamic University Malaysia. “我们的祖先没有上过学。但他们能建造适应气候的建筑，”马来西亚国际伊斯兰大学建筑学教授阿卜杜勒·拉扎克·本·萨皮安说。 One such example can be seen from the upper floors of the Oxley: a neighborhood, just a half-mile away, that looks from above like a toy village. Surrounded by high rises, it is an island of one- and two-story homes, preserved almost by accident because of colonial-era laws that created an enclave for ethnic Malay ownership. 从豪利大厦的高处可以看到一个这样的例子：半英里外的一个街区，从上面看像玩具村庄。它被高楼环绕，是一两层住宅组成的岛屿，几乎像是偶然保留下来的，因为殖民时代的法律为马来族所有权创造了一块飞地。 That has left the neighborhood, Kampung Baru, as an architectural time capsule. People hang out in open-air restaurants under ceiling fans, and many homes have large overhangs that ward off the sun. Small windows are covered by horizontal louvers. 这使甘榜巴鲁街区成为一个建筑时间胶囊。人们在吊扇下的露天餐厅消遣，许多住宅有宽大的屋檐遮阳。小窗户被水平百叶窗覆盖。 在传统的甘榜巴鲁社区，在空调时代到来之前，建筑的设计旨在缓解酷热。贾米亚·凯索特在家中。 One of the oldest homes in the neighborhood belongs to Jamiyah Kesot, 71. Constructed of dark timber with a high-pitched roof, it relies on the cooling features from a different time. It is built on stilts, allowing airflow from below. Ms. Kesot’s monthly energy bill is around $15. She uses two floor fans and no air-conditioning. 该街区最古老的住宅之一属于71岁的贾米亚·凯索特。这栋房子由深色木材建造，屋顶高耸，依赖的是另一个时代的降温特性。房子有高脚，让空气从下方流通。凯索特每月的能源账单约15美元。她使用两台落地扇，不用空调。 “I don’t need it,” said Ms. Kesot, a grandmother of seven who worked on a Texas Instruments assembly line for 37 years before retiring in 2011. “我不需要空调，”凯索特说。她有七个孙辈，曾在得克萨斯仪器公司装配线上工作37年，2011年退休。 Most days last summer, the outdoor temperature rose into the 90s. And Ms. Kesot’s home, at least to an unacclimated visitor, still felt punishingly humid. But one afternoon a thunderstorm rolled in. Wind rippled through the louvers, flapping the curtains, and the home filled with fresh air. 去年夏天大多数日子，室外温度在摄氏32度以上。凯索特的家，至少对一个不适应的访客来说，仍然感觉闷热难耐。但一天下午，一场雷暴袭来。风穿过百叶窗，吹动窗帘，家中充满新鲜空气。 From her living room, as the thunder crackled, Ms. Kesot had no panoramic view of the soaring buildings all around her or the dramatic skies about Kuala Lumpur. For that, she’d have to go outside. 在客厅里，雷声噼啪作响，凯索特没有周围高耸建筑的那种全景视野，也看不到吉隆坡那动人心魄的天空。要看的话，她得走到外面去。 Chico Harlan是《纽约时报》的全球气候记者。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。
items.content: CHICO HARLAN, ZUNAIRA SAIEED 2026年10月30日 Ulet Ifansasti for The New York Times One thousand feet above city traffic, from her new 74th-floor apartment, Anastasia Zeeman has the kind of enchanting views that only floor-to-ceiling glass can offer. She looks out on a skyline and horizon where storms and sunsets play out like big-screen movies. 城市车流上方约300米处，阿纳斯塔西娅·齐曼在她位于74层的新公寓里欣赏着只有落地玻璃才能提供的迷人景色。她眺望天际线和地平线，风暴与日落交织的景象宛如大银幕电影般上演。 But Malaysia’s tropical sun sometimes delivers what Ms. Zeeman calls a “wall of heat” radiating from her windows. 但马来西亚的热带阳光有时会带来齐曼所说的“热墙”，从她的窗户辐射进来。 More than any other form of architecture, glass skyscrapers testify to the human desire for sweeping views and a sense of rising above the fray. In some of the world’s fastest developing places — Dubai, Mumbai, Jakarta, Kuala Lumpur — they have become city-defining showpieces, signaling sophistication and rising financial clout. 与其他任何建筑形式相比，玻璃摩天大楼最能体现人类对开阔视野的向往，以及凌驾于尘嚣之上的追求。在迪拜、孟买、雅加达、吉隆坡等全球发展最迅速的城市中，它们已成为定义城市风貌的标志性建筑，象征着精致和日益增强的金融影响力。 And yet glass tends to be ill-suited for keeping out the heat, and its overuse often makes buildings more energy intensive to cool. That’s fueling a debate about whether these symbols of modernity make sense in a world growing hotter because of climate change. 然而，玻璃往往不适合阻隔热量，其过度使用常常使建筑冷却所需能耗更高。这引发了一场辩论：在因气候变化而日益炎热的世界里，这些现代性的象征是否还有意义。 Some argue that the ambition and innovation that spawned the high-rise era can help modern skyscrapers fend off rising temperatures while maintaining the million-dollar views. Others say the all-glass aesthetic is at odds with the environmental goal of reducing greenhouse-gas emissions. They say it is time to rethink city skylines. 一些人认为，凭借催生摩天大楼时代的雄心和创新，现代摩天大楼能够在保持价值百万美元的壮丽景观同时抵御气温上升。另一些人说，全玻璃美学与减少温室气体排放的环境目标相悖。他们说，是时候对城市天际线进行重新思考了。 When he was New York City mayor in 2019, Bill de Blasio briefly floated the idea of banning the “glass and steel” structures altogether. Philip Oldfield, an Australian architecture scholar who wrote a book on sustainable high rises, calls the glass towers “environmentally criminal.” Ken Shuttleworth, a prominent British architect who three decades ago helped design London’s Gherkin building, now says he’d do it differently, without quite as much glass all the way around. 2019年担任纽约市长时，比尔·德布拉西奥曾短暂提出全面禁止“玻璃和钢铁”结构的想法。写过一本关于可持续高层建筑书籍的澳大利亚建筑学者菲利普·奥德菲尔德称，玻璃摩天楼“在环境上是犯罪”。30年前曾参与设计伦敦“小黄瓜”大楼的英国著名建筑师肯·沙特尔斯沃思表示，现在他会采用不同方案，不会四周都使用那么多玻璃。 “You really just need to have smaller windows,” said Mr. Shuttleworth. He said his approach to skyscraper design has changed as he’s come to realize that “we are burning a hole in the planet.” “你其实只需要把窗户做小一些，”沙特尔斯沃思说。他说，随着他逐渐意识到“我们正在把地球烧出一个洞”，他对摩天大楼设计的思路已经改变。 穿透科威特的浓雾。 伦敦著名“小黄瓜”大楼的建筑师之一表示，如果今天重新设计，他会减少玻璃的使用量。 Despite that criticism, the glass skyscraper’s appeal endures. 尽管有这些批评，玻璃摩天大楼的魅力依然不减。 The form, which originated in American cities like Chicago and New York, has now spread across China, the Middle East and Southeast Asia. Over the past decade, the world has constructed 25 times the number of buildings 200 meters (roughly 655 feet) or taller that it did in the 1980s, according to the Council on Tall Buildings and Urban Habitat. Some 91 percent of the world’s skyscrapers of that height have been built since the turn of the 21st century. 这种形式起源于芝加哥和纽约等美国城市，如今已传播到中国、中东和东南亚。根据高层建筑与城市人居委员会的数据，过去十年，全球建造的200米或更高建筑数量是1980年代的25倍。世界上约91%的这一高度摩天大楼是在进入21世纪以来建造的。 The “vast majority” have facades largely of glass, said Antony Wood, who was the president of that council until last year. 该委员会任期至去年的前主席安东尼·伍德说，“绝大多数”建筑的外立面主要是玻璃。 Proponents of glass-dominant design say this building spree can still be responsible if strategic choices are made. 支持玻璃为主设计方案的人士认为，只要做出战略选择，这种建筑热潮仍然可以做到环保。 Because the sun doesn’t hit a building equally from all directions, buildings can boost their energy efficiency simply with the right orientation. Architects can also add features like fins or undulations so less sunlight directly hits the glass. Stringing greenery on glass facades is also a trend. 因为太阳并非从所有方向均匀照射建筑，建筑只需通过合理的朝向设计，就能提高能源效率。建筑师还可以添加翅片或起伏等特征，减少阳光直射玻璃。在玻璃外立面上布置绿植也是一种趋势。 Glass can also be treated with gossamer-thin metallic coatings that reflect away radiation. Most buildings use several layers of glass to impede the heat. One high-end option involves sandwiching automated blinds between them. 玻璃还可以涂覆薄如蛛丝的金属涂层，以反射辐射热。大多数建筑使用多层玻璃来阻挡热量。一种高端选择是在玻璃之间夹入自动百叶窗。 “It’s not as simple as people think it is,” said Gordon Gill, an architect at Adrian Smith + Gordon Gill. He has helped design numerous skyscrapers, including a 1,000-meter tower in Saudi Arabia that will be the world’s tallest once completed. “I’m not a big fan of, ‘Aha, we found the answer: We’re just going to use less glass.’ I don’t believe in panaceas. Your entire process is about balance.” “这并不像人们想的那么简单，”阿德里安·史密斯+戈登·吉尔建筑事务所的建筑师戈登·吉尔说。他帮助设计了众多摩天大楼，包括 沙特阿拉伯一座1000米高的塔楼 ，建成后将成为世界最高建筑。“我不太赞同那种‘啊哈，我们找到答案了：少用点玻璃就行’的想法。我不相信万灵药。你的整个过程都关乎平衡。” Most studies conclude that cutting down on glazing, as glass is sometimes called, does help reduce energy for cooling. A 2019 analysis of 1,000 American office buildings found that structures with larger window ratios had higher air-conditioning loads — though window size didn’t predict a building’s overall energy use. A research paper from Saudi Arabia concluded that glazing “should be minimized in hot regions,” with windows ideally amounting to 20 to 30 percent of the facade. 大多数研究得出结论，减少玻璃确实有助于降低冷却能耗。2019年对1000栋美国办公楼的分析发现，窗户比例越大的建筑，空调负荷越高——尽管窗户大小并不能预测建筑的整体能耗。沙特阿拉伯的一篇研究论文得出结论，在炎热地区“应尽量减少”玻璃的使用，理想情况下，窗户应占外立面的20%到30%。 But skyscrapers, of course, are so much more than objects meant to maximize efficiency. Big windows let in natural light, which limits the need for artificial lighting. 但摩天大楼当然不仅仅是为了最大限度提高能效而存在的。大窗户能引入自然光，从而减少对人工照明的需求。 They also help units sell. 它们也有助于房屋销售。 “默德卡118”是世界第二高的摩天大楼，为吉隆坡的天际线增添了一抹亮色。 阿纳斯塔西娅·齐曼站在Oxley大楼的泳池旁，该建筑采用落地玻璃设计。 Ms. Zeeman, for example, had looked at seven or eight properties before walking into Oxley Towers, one of which is Kuala Lumpur’s sixth-tallest building. She’d moved from the Dutch countryside with her husband, who’d gotten an engineering job in the city. They saw the panorama and paid over their budget. 例如，齐曼女士在走进豪利大厦之前看过七八处房产，其中一栋是吉隆坡第六高的建筑。她和丈夫从荷兰乡村搬来，丈夫在这座城市找到了一份工程工作。他们看到全景后，以超出预算的价格买下了房子。 “To wake up with this view, it’s a completely different mood,” she said. “It inspires me to do more.” “每天清晨醒来就能看到这样的景色，心情完全不一样，”她说。“它激励我做更多事情。” ‘Beautiful to the eye’ “赏心悦目” Glass has helped give Malaysia the very thing its prime minister said he wanted three decades ago: buildings that evoke development and are “ beautiful to the eye .” 玻璃帮助马来西亚实现了其总理30年前期盼的目标：既象征着发展又“ 赏心悦目 ”的建筑。 The country started in 1996 by completing the twin Petronas Towers, the tallest buildings in the world at the time. Then it kept going, constructing hundreds more skyscrapers — including two taller than Petronas. Malaysia, with just 35 million people, now has more buildings 200 meters or higher than any country but China, the United States and the United Arab Emirates. 马来西亚于1996年建成了双子塔，当时它们是世界最高建筑。从那以后，它继续建造了数百座摩天大楼，其中包括两座比双子塔更高的建筑。马来西亚只有3500万人口，如今其200米及以上高层建筑数量仅次于中国、美国和阿联酋，位居世界第四。 Some of them, particularly ones with top-end technology, have good energy efficiency numbers, said Sarly Adre Sarkum, an architect and the chief executive of Malaysia’s Green Building Index. But Mr. Sarkum said the overall quality of the towers is “still not so good.” He said that in Malaysia’s climate, extensive glass facades carry “significant energy consequences.” 其中一些建筑，尤其是采用尖端技术的建筑，能源效率指标相当不错，马来西亚绿色建筑指数首席执行官、建筑师萨利·阿德雷·萨尔库姆说。但他指出，这些高楼的整体质量“仍然不太理想”。在马来西亚的气候条件下，大面积使用玻璃幕墙会带来“显著的能源消耗问题”。 马来西亚绿色建筑指数首席执行官萨莉·阿德雷·萨库姆。 吉隆坡的新建项目。 Roughly 60 percent of the building energy use in Malaysia stems from air-conditioning, Mr. Sarkum said. “When buyers purchase these, they think they get great views,” Mr. Sarkum said. “But you need to keep the curtains closed.” 萨尔库姆说，马来西亚约60%的建筑能耗来自空调。“买房的人觉得，这样可以欣赏到绝佳的风景，”他说。“但实际上，你得一直拉着窗帘。” The Oxley Towers, where Ms. Zeeman lives, represents one of the city’s heaviest uses of glass. Even the bathrooms next to the gym have floor-to-ceiling windows. 齐曼女士居住的奥克斯利大厦是这座城市玻璃使用量最大的建筑之一。甚至健身房旁边的卫生间也有落地窗。 The Oxley was designed by a firm founded by David Mizan Hashim, a self-described “idealist” who obtained his master’s degree from Harvard in 1986 and launched his company, Veritas, soon after. Veritas says it accepts only projects that aim for green certifications. 奥克斯利大厦由戴维·米赞·哈希姆创立的公司设计。哈希姆自称“理想主义者”，1986年在哈佛获得硕士学位，不久后创立了Veritas。该公司表示，只承接以获得绿色建筑认证为目标的项目。 But Dr. Hashim acknowledged that his idealism doesn’t always play out, given the trade-offs over aesthetics and performance. “This is the struggle of my life,” he said. 但哈希姆承认，考虑到建筑美观与性能之间需要作出取舍，他的理想主义并不总能付诸实践。“这是我一生都在应对的难题，”他说。 林立的玻璃摩天大楼是吉隆坡彰显现代感的一个方面。 戴维·米赞·哈希姆（中）表示，在追求高效建筑与满足商业期望之间取得平衡“是我一生都在应对的难题”。 For one thing, developers of residential high rises don’t wind up paying the energy bills. “So there is less of an incentive for them to go all-out,” Dr. Hashim said. 其中一个问题是，住宅高楼的开发商最终并不需要支付能源账单。“因此，他们缺乏全力提高能效的动力，”哈希姆说。 The Singapore-based company that developed Oxley said in a sustainability report that it works “continuously” to improve the efficiency of its properties, and uses energy-efficient air-conditioning systems and motion-sensor lighting where possible. It says Oxley Towers have “high-quality glazing” that “reduces the need for extensive air-conditioning.” 开发奥克斯利大厦的新加坡公司在一份可持续发展报告中表示，公司“持续”致力于提高旗下物业的能源效率，并在条件允许的情况下使用节能空调系统和感应式照明。公司称，奥克斯利大厦采用了“高品质玻璃”，能够“减少对大量使用空调的需求”。 Even so, Dr. Hashim said, the building is “not as cutting-edge as it could be.” That’s because the development company wanted a relatively unadorned look, which removed the possibility of adding shading features. “That was an aesthetic choice,” Dr. Hashim said. 即便如此，哈希姆说，这栋建筑“没有达到它本可以有的前沿水平”。这是因为开发单位想要相对朴素的外观，因此无法增设遮阳设施。“那是出于美观作出的选择，”哈希姆说。 The development company, Oxley Holdings Limited, did not respond to a request for comment. 开发公司豪利控股没有回应置评请求。 The towers will likely obtain a silver rating from Malaysia’s rating index, the third-highest level, he said, though Dr. Hashim had hoped it could be gold. Ultimately, he said, “it is a building that is being sold.” 哈希姆说，这几栋大楼很可能获得马来西亚绿色建筑评级体系的银级认证，这是该体系的第三高等级，尽管他原本希望能达到金级。归根结底，他说，“这是一栋要拿来卖的楼”。 The power of air-conditioning 空调如何改变一切 The glass skyscraper became viable only with the advent of air-conditioning. 直到空调问世，玻璃摩天大楼才成为可能。 Before then, high rises were built primarily out of heavy masonry, with windows as little cutouts. That aesthetic now looks old-fashioned. But in a 2023 study comparing the energy efficiency of nine New York City high rises, the oldest skyscraper — the Chrysler Building, constructed in 1929 — was by far the best performer. 在那之前，高层建筑主要用厚重的砖石建造，窗户只是墙面上一个个小小的开口。这种建筑风格如今看起来已经过时。然而，2023年的一项研究比较了纽约市九栋高层建筑的能源效率，结果发现，其中历史最悠久的摩天大楼——建于1929年的克莱斯勒大厦——能效表现遥遥领先。 Even in Malaysia, the first modestly tall buildings looked as if they were in an almost defensive stance against the sun. 即使在马来西亚，最早的那些不算太高的高层建筑看起来也几乎像是在对太阳严防死守。 The 18-story parliament building of the 1960s, Malaysia’s tallest at the time, came wrapped in a honeycomb-like lattice. The Dayabumi Complex, built in the 1980s, had its windows shrouded behind an ornate white veil inspired by Islamic motifs. 1960年代的18层国会大厦是当时马来西亚最高的建筑，外面包裹着蜂窝状格栅。1980年代建成的达雅布米综合体，其窗户隐藏在受伊斯兰图案启发的华丽白色遮挡物后面。 Stellios Plainiotis, the chief executive of a facade consulting company in Kuala Lumpur, said Malaysia was “effectively experimenting with what a skyscraper for the tropics should look like.” Some of those ideas now feel “remarkably current,” he said. 吉隆坡一家外立面咨询公司首席执行官斯特利奥斯·普莱尼奥蒂斯说，马来西亚“实际上一直在试验热带摩天大楼应该是什么样子”。他说，其中一些想法现在感觉“非常入时”。 Critics of the all-glass approach say air-conditioning excused architects to ignore other design lessons about contending with heat. Those include techniques honed over centuries in warm environments, such as the white, sun-reflective facades of Greece or the open, traditional homes of Southeast Asia. 全玻璃的批评者说，空调让建筑师有借口忽视其他应对高温的设计经验。这些经验包括数百年在炎热环境中磨练出来的技术，比如希腊白色的反光外立面，或东南亚的开放式传统住宅。 马来西亚的200米及以上高层建筑数量仅次于中国、美国和阿联酋，位居世界第四。 今年夏天的大多数日子里，马来西亚首都的室外气温都超过了32摄氏度。 “Our ancestors, they didn’t go to school. And yet they could build buildings that respond to the climate,” said Abdul Razak Bin Sapian, a professor of architecture at the International Islamic University Malaysia. “我们的祖先没有上过学。但他们能建造适应气候的建筑，”马来西亚国际伊斯兰大学建筑学教授阿卜杜勒·拉扎克·本·萨皮安说。 One such example can be seen from the upper floors of the Oxley: a neighborhood, just a half-mile away, that looks from above like a toy village. Surrounded by high rises, it is an island of one- and two-story homes, preserved almost by accident because of colonial-era laws that created an enclave for ethnic Malay ownership. 从豪利大厦的高处可以看到一个这样的例子：半英里外的一个街区，从上面看像玩具村庄。它被高楼环绕，是一两层住宅组成的岛屿，几乎像是偶然保留下来的，因为殖民时代的法律为马来族所有权创造了一块飞地。 That has left the neighborhood, Kampung Baru, as an architectural time capsule. People hang out in open-air restaurants under ceiling fans, and many homes have large overhangs that ward off the sun. Small windows are covered by horizontal louvers. 这使甘榜巴鲁街区成为一个建筑时间胶囊。人们在吊扇下的露天餐厅消遣，许多住宅有宽大的屋檐遮阳。小窗户被水平百叶窗覆盖。 在传统的甘榜巴鲁社区，在空调时代到来之前，建筑的设计旨在缓解酷热。 贾米亚·凯索特在家中。 One of the oldest homes in the neighborhood belongs to Jamiyah Kesot, 71. Constructed of dark timber with a high-pitched roof, it relies on the cooling features from a different time. It is built on stilts, allowing airflow from below. Ms. Kesot’s monthly energy bill is around $15. She uses two floor fans and no air-conditioning. 该街区最古老的住宅之一属于71岁的贾米亚·凯索特。这栋房子由深色木材建造，屋顶高耸，依赖的是另一个时代的降温特性。房子有高脚，让空气从下方流通。凯索特每月的能源账单约15美元。她使用两台落地扇，不用空调。 “I don’t need it,” said Ms. Kesot, a grandmother of seven who worked on a Texas Instruments assembly line for 37 years before retiring in 2011. “我不需要空调，”凯索特说。她有七个孙辈，曾在得克萨斯仪器公司装配线上工作37年，2011年退休。 Most days last summer, the outdoor temperature rose into the 90s. And Ms. Kesot’s home, at least to an unacclimated visitor, still felt punishingly humid. But one afternoon a thunderstorm rolled in. Wind rippled through the louvers, flapping the curtains, and the home filled with fresh air. 去年夏天大多数日子，室外温度在摄氏32度以上。凯索特的家，至少对一个不适应的访客来说，仍然感觉闷热难耐。但一天下午，一场雷暴袭来。风穿过百叶窗，吹动窗帘，家中充满新鲜空气。 From her living room, as the thunder crackled, Ms. Kesot had no panoramic view of the soaring buildings all around her or the dramatic skies about Kuala Lumpur. For that, she’d have to go outside. 在客厅里，雷声噼啪作响，凯索特没有周围高耸建筑的那种全景视野，也看不到吉隆坡那动人心魄的天空。要看的话，她得走到外面去。 Chico Harlan 是《纽约时报》的全球气候记者。 翻译：纽约时报中文网 点击查看本文英文版。

items.title: thedotmack/claude-mem
items.description: Persistent Context Across Sessions for Every Agent – Captures everything your agent does during sessions, compresses it with AI, and injects relevant context back into future sessions. Works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, Codex, Gemini, Hermes, Copilot, OpenCode + More https://claude-mem.ai 🇨🇳 中文 • 🇹🇼 繁體中文 • 🇯🇵 日本語 • 🇵🇹 Português • 🇧🇷 Português • 🇰🇷 한국어 • 🇪🇸 Español • 🇩🇪 Deutsch • 🇫🇷 Français • 🇮🇱 עברית • 🇸🇦 العربية • 🇷🇺 Русский • 🇵🇱 Polski • 🇨🇿 Čeština • 🇳🇱 Nederlands • 🇹🇷 Türkçe • 🇺🇦 Українська • 🇻🇳 Tiếng Việt • 🇵🇭 Tagalog • 🇮🇩 Indonesia • 🇹🇭 ไทย • 🇮🇳 हिन्दी • 🇧🇩 বাংলা • 🇵🇰 اردو • 🇷🇴 Română • 🇸🇪 Svenska • 🇮🇹 Italiano • 🇬🇷 Ελληνικά • 🇭🇺 Magyar • 🇫🇮 Suomi • 🇩🇰 Dansk • 🇳🇴 Norsk Persistent memory compression system built for Claude Code. Quick Start • How It Works • Search Tools • Documentation • Configuration • Troubleshooting • License Claude-Mem seamlessly preserves context across sessions by automatically capturing tool usage observations, generating semantic summaries, and making them available to future sessions. This enables Claude to maintain continuity of knowledge about projects even after sessions end or reconnect. Quick Start Install claude-mem for Grok Bot: npx claude-mem install --ide grok-bot Grok Bot has no host hooks, so we watch the chat log files. Default is CMEM Pro, the hosted memory. Local observer is opt-in: --provider host. Installing this plugin does not install Cursor. Awareness push pilot (LFG + Orifice): needle observations (decision, bugfix, security_alert, sensitive) are appended as dated - YYYY-MM-DD [awareness] … lines into that bot's memory/log/YYYY-MM.md. Grok Bot already re-reads the log from disk. This does not write profile.md, user-memory, or project memory. Disable with CLAUDE_MEM_GROK_BOT_AWARENESS_ENABLED=false. Install with a single command: npx claude-mem install The installer sets everything up first, then asks you to sign in to claude-mem in your browser (email magic link — no card required). Signing in provisions a memory key for your account and unlocks the claude-mem observer with a 30 Day Free Trial: memory runs off-plan, so you get up to 100% more usage from your plan. When the free trial ends, memory automatically falls back to your Anthropic plan unless you subscribe. After sign-in you pick your memory provider — the claude-mem observer, your own OpenRouter or Gemini key, or your Anthropic plan. Prefer to skip the sign-in? Pass an explicit --provider flag, set CLAUDE_MEM_ONLINE_OPTIN=false, or run in CI/non-interactive shells — the installer completes without any account interaction. Or install for OpenCode: npx claude-mem install --ide opencode This works with OpenCode 1.3.4 or later, including OpenCode 2. Restart OpenCode after installing. Or install for T3 Code (Codex and Claude Code providers): npx claude-mem install --ide t3code The installer discovers T3 Code's enabled providers, registers native Claude-Mem plugins in their configured homes, and supports T3-managed Codex. Restart T3 Code, trust the provider's hooks when prompted, and start a new thread. See the T3 Code integration guide for custom server settings, status, and removal. Or install for Antigravity CLI (setup guide): npx claude-mem install --ide antigravity Or install for OMP (Oh My Pi): npx claude-mem install --ide omp Or install the native Pi extension or DeepSeek Harness plugin: npx claude-mem install --ide pi npx claude-mem install --ide dsh --dsh-profile tui Pi and DeepSeek Harness use the worker runtime. See native harness setup for capture, recall, and troubleshooting. items.description: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation https://lightpanda.io Lightpanda Browser The headless browser built from scratch for AI agents and automation. Not a Chromium fork. Not a WebKit patch. A new browser, written in Zig. 16x lighter and 9x faster than Chromium. Benchmarks Requesting 933 real web pages over the network on a AWS EC2 m5.large instance. See benchmark details. Metric Lightpanda Headless Chrome Difference Memory (peak, 100 pages) 123MB 2GB ~16x less Execution time (100 pages) 5s 46s ~9x faster Quick start Install Package Managers Latest nightly from Homebrew: brew install lightpanda-io/browser/lightpanda Latest nightly from Arch Linux User Repository: yay -S lightpanda-nightly-bin Download from the nightly builds You can download the last binary from the nightly builds for Linux and MacOS for both x86_64 and aarch64. For Linux curl -L -o lightpanda https://github.com/lightpanda-io/browser/releases/download/nightly/lightpanda-x86_64-linux && \ chmod a+x ./lightpanda Verify the binary before running anything: ./lightpanda version Linux aarch64 is also available If you use Nix, you can run Lightpanda directly from the flake without downloading a binary: nix run github:lightpanda-io/browser -- --help Or pin it as an input in your own flake: { inputs.lightpanda.url = "github:lightpanda-io/browser"; } Note: The Linux release binaries are linked against glibc. On musl-based Linux distributions (Alpine, etc.) the binary fails with cannot execute: required file not found because the glibc dynamic linker is missing. Use a glibc-based base image: the current release binaries need glibc 2.35 (x86_64) or 2.38 (arm64), so debian:bookworm-slim (2.36) is fine on x86_64 but too old for arm64 — use FROM ubuntu:24.04, FROM debian:trixie-slim, or FROM debian:forky-slim there — or build from sources. Android / Termux: there is no native Android build. The Linux aarch64 binary needs the glibc loader (/lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1), which Android's Bionic libc does not provide, so it fails with the same cannot execute: required file not found error. For MacOS curl -L -o lightpanda https://github.com/lightpanda-io/browser/releases/download/nightly/lightpanda-aarch64-macos && \ chmod a+x ./lightpanda MacOS x86_64 is also available For Windows + WSL2 Lightpanda has no native Windows binary. Install it inside WSL following the Linux steps above. WSL not installed? Run wsl --install from an administrator shell, restart, then open wsl. See Microsoft's WSL install guide for details. Your automation client (Puppeteer, Playwright, etc.) can run either inside WSL or on the Windows host. WSL forwards localhost:9222 automatically. Install from Docker Lightpanda provides official Docker images for both Linux amd64 and arm64 architectures. The following command fetches the Docker image and starts a new container exposing Lightpanda's CDP server on port 9222. docker run -d --name lightpanda -p 127.0.0.1:9222:9222 lightpanda/browser:latest Dump a URL ./lightpanda fetch --obey-robots --dump html --log-format pretty --log-level info https://demo-browser.lightpanda.io/campfire-commerce/ You can use --dump markdown to convert directly into markdown, or --dump png > page.png or --dump pdf > page.pdf for a text-only rendering of the page. --dump structured_data prints the page's JSON-LD, OpenGraph, Twitter card, meta and link tags as JSON, like the MCP structuredData tool. --wait-until, --wait-ms, --wait-selector and --wait-script are available to adjust waiting time before dump. Start a CDP server ./lightpanda serve --obey-robots --log-format pretty --log-level info --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9222 To listen on a Unix-domain socket (owner-only, mode 0600) instead of TCP: ./lightpanda serve --unix-socket /run/user/1000/lightpanda.sock Once the CDP server started, you can run a Puppeteer script by configuring the browserWSEndpoint. Example Puppeteer script import puppeteer from 'puppeteer-core'; // use browserWSEndpoint to pass the Lightpanda's CDP server address. const browser = await puppeteer.connect({ browserWSEndpoint: "ws://127.0.0.1:9222", }); // The rest of your script remains the same. const context = await browser.createBrowserContext(); const frame = await context.newPage(); // Dump all the links from the frame. await frame.goto('https://demo-browser.lightpanda.io/amiibo/', {waitUntil: "networkidle0"}); const links = await frame.evaluate(() => { return Array.from(document.querySelectorAll('a')).map(row => { return row.getAttribute('href'); }); }); console.log(links); await frame.close(); await context.close(); await browser.disconnect(); Start a webdriver Bidi server Use --protocol webdriver to enable Bidi support. You can start both, CDP and Bidi, with --protocol webdriver --protocol cdp ./lightpanda serve --obey-robots --log-format pretty --log-level info --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9222 --protocol webdriver Agent mode lightpanda agent lets you drive the browser with a native agent. Describe what you want in plain English or with slash commands, and it controls the browser: navigating pages, clicking through flows, filling forms, extracting structured data. Think of it as a robot you're directing to use the web, more than a chatbot you're having a conversation with. Because the agent runs inside the same process as the browser, every tool call is a direct operation and you retain Lightpanda's speed and memory advantage. The output of an agent session is a PandaScript: vanilla JavaScript with a small set of native browser primitives built directly into Lightpanda. Run /save to export one from your current session, then replay it with lightpanda run .js. Scripts are deterministic and token-free, so you can prototype with the LLM and ship the output to production without a model at runtime. It supports Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Google Vertex AI, Mistral, Hugging Face, the multi-lab gateways Vercel AI Gateway and OpenRouter (one key for hundreds of models), any OpenAI-compatible endpoint via OPENAI_BASE_URL, and local models via Ollama, llama.cpp or LLMD. You can also run without an LLM using --no-llm, which drops you into the REPL. See the agent documentation for the full reference. ./lightpanda agent # auto-detects API key from env ./lightpanda agent --task "top story on news.ycombinator.com?" ./lightpanda agent --no-llm # basic REPL, no LLM ./lightpanda run session.js # run a recorded script cat session.js | ./lightpanda run - # ...or pipe one in via stdin ./lightpanda agent --provider gemini --task "..." # force a specific provider ./lightpanda agent --list-models # models available for the detected provider VERTEX_API_KEY=... ./lightpanda agent --provider vertex # Vertex AI, express mode GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=my-proj ./lightpanda agent --provider vertex # Vertex AI, token via gcloud auth AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY=... ./lightpanda agent --provider vercel --model moonshotai/kimi-k2 # any model behind Vercel AI Gateway OPENROUTER_API_KEY=... ./lightpanda agent --provider openrouter --model anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 # any model behind OpenRouter OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://my-gateway/v1 OPENAI_API_KEY=... ./lightpanda agent # any OpenAI-compatible server Native MCP and skill The MCP server communicates via MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio. Add to your MCP configuration: { "mcpServers": { "lightpanda": { "command": "/path/to/lightpanda", "args": ["mcp"] } } } HTTP transport and independent sessions For serving several agents from one process, start the MCP server over HTTP instead of stdio by giving it a port (add --host x.x.x.x to specify the interface to listen on): lightpanda mcp --port 9223 Clients POST JSON-RPC to http://host:9223/mcp. Each connection is routed to its own browsing session — its own page, cookies and memory — so agents no longer clobber each other's page: A client that initializes without an Mcp-Session-Id header is assigned a fresh session; the id comes back in the response's Mcp-Session-Id header. Send it on subsequent requests to stay on that session (isolation). Two agents that send the same Mcp-Session-Id share one browsing context (sharing — e.g. a workflow where several agents work the same page). The session_new, session_list and session_close tools manage sessions explicitly. Sending DELETE /mcp with an Mcp-Session-Id closes that session. The run tool runs a PandaScript in the caller's session, as lightpanda run does, and returns its console output and the value it returns. It takes the source as script, or the path of a file that save wrote. Pages the script opens are closed when it ends; cookies and storage stay, so a login carries over to the next run. An optional timeout in milliseconds (default 60000) stops a stuck script. A backend can drive Lightpanda with one POST: curl -s http://127.0.0.1:9223/mcp -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{ "jsonrpc": "2.0", "id": 1, "method": "tools/call", "params": { "name": "run", "arguments": { "script": "const page = new Page();\nawait page.goto(\"https://example.com\");\nreturn page.extract({ title: \"title\", links: [\"a\"] });" } } }' Read full documentation A skill is available in lightpanda-io/agent-skill. You must sign our CLA during the pull request process. Discord Why Lightpanda? Javascript execution is mandatory for the modern web Simple HTTP requests used to be enough for web automation. That's no longer the case. Javascript now drives most of the web: Ajax, Single Page Apps, infinite loading, instant search JS frameworks: React, Vue, Angular, and others Chrome is not the right tool Running a full desktop browser on a server works, but it does not scale well. Chrome at hundreds or thousands of instances is expensive: Heavy on RAM and CPU Hard to package, deploy, and maintain at scale Many features are not necessary in headless made Lightpanda is built for performance Supporting Javascript with real performance meant building from scratch rather than forking Chromium: Not based on Chromium, Blink, or WebKit Written in Zig, a low-level language with explicit memory control No graphical rendering engine
items.content: Lightpanda: the headless browser designed for AI and automation https://lightpanda.io Lightpanda Browser The headless browser built from scratch for AI agents and automation. Not a Chromium fork. Not a WebKit patch. A new browser, written in Zig. 16x lighter and 9x faster than Chromium. Benchmarks Requesting 933 real web pages over the network on a AWS EC2 m5.large instance. See benchmark details . Metric Lightpanda Headless Chrome Difference Memory (peak, 100 pages) 123MB 2GB ~16x less Execution time (100 pages) 5s 46s ~9x faster Quick start Install Package Managers Latest nightly from Homebrew: brew install lightpanda-io/browser/lightpanda Latest nightly from Arch Linux User Repository: yay -S lightpanda-nightly-bin Download from the nightly builds You can download the last binary from the nightly builds for Linux and MacOS for both x86_64 and aarch64. For Linux curl -L -o lightpanda https://github.com/lightpanda-io/browser/releases/download/nightly/lightpanda-x86_64-linux && \ chmod a+x ./lightpanda Verify the binary before running anything: ./lightpanda version Linux aarch64 is also available If you use Nix , you can run Lightpanda directly from the flake without downloading a binary: nix run github:lightpanda-io/browser -- --help Or pin it as an input in your own flake: { inputs.lightpanda.url = "github:lightpanda-io/browser"; } Note: The Linux release binaries are linked against glibc. On musl-based Linux distributions (Alpine, etc.) the binary fails with cannot execute: required file not found because the glibc dynamic linker is missing. Use a glibc-based base image: the current release binaries need glibc 2.35 ( x86_64 ) or 2.38 ( arm64 ), so debian:bookworm-slim (2.36) is fine on x86_64 but too old for arm64 — use FROM ubuntu:24.04 , FROM debian:trixie-slim , or FROM debian:forky-slim there — or build from sources . Android / Termux: there is no native Android build. The Linux aarch64 binary needs the glibc loader ( /lib/ld-linux-aarch64.so.1 ), which Android's Bionic libc does not provide, so it fails with the same cannot execute: required file not found error. For MacOS curl -L -o lightpanda https://github.com/lightpanda-io/browser/releases/download/nightly/lightpanda-aarch64-macos && \ chmod a+x ./lightpanda MacOS x86_64 is also available For Windows + WSL2 Lightpanda has no native Windows binary. Install it inside WSL following the Linux steps above. WSL not installed? Run wsl --install from an administrator shell, restart, then open wsl . See Microsoft's WSL install guide for details. Your automation client (Puppeteer, Playwright, etc.) can run either inside WSL or on the Windows host. WSL forwards localhost:9222 automatically. Install from Docker Lightpanda provides official Docker images for both Linux amd64 and arm64 architectures. The following command fetches the Docker image and starts a new container exposing Lightpanda's CDP server on port 9222 . docker run -d --name lightpanda -p 127.0.0.1:9222:9222 lightpanda/browser:latest Dump a URL ./lightpanda fetch --obey-robots --dump html --log-format pretty --log-level info https://demo-browser.lightpanda.io/campfire-commerce/ You can use --dump markdown to convert directly into markdown, or --dump png > page.png or --dump pdf > page.pdf for a text-only rendering of the page. --dump structured_data prints the page's JSON-LD, OpenGraph, Twitter card, meta and link tags as JSON, like the MCP structuredData tool. --wait-until , --wait-ms , --wait-selector and --wait-script are available to adjust waiting time before dump. Start a CDP server ./lightpanda serve --obey-robots --log-format pretty --log-level info --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9222 To listen on a Unix-domain socket (owner-only, mode 0600) instead of TCP: ./lightpanda serve --unix-socket /run/user/1000/lightpanda.sock Once the CDP server started, you can run a Puppeteer script by configuring the browserWSEndpoint . You can start both, CDP and Bidi, with --protocol webdriver --protocol cdp ./lightpanda serve --obey-robots --log-format pretty --log-level info --host 127.0.0.1 --port 9222 --protocol webdriver Agent mode lightpanda agent lets you drive the browser with a native agent. Describe what you want in plain English or with slash commands, and it controls the browser: navigating pages, clicking through flows, filling forms, extracting structured data. Think of it as a robot you're directing to use the web, more than a chatbot you're having a conversation with. Because the agent runs inside the same process as the browser, every tool call is a direct operation and you retain Lightpanda's speed and memory advantage. The output of an agent session is a PandaScript : vanilla JavaScript with a small set of native browser primitives built directly into Lightpanda. It supports Anthropic, OpenAI, Gemini, Google Vertex AI, Mistral, Hugging Face, the multi-lab gateways Vercel AI Gateway and OpenRouter (one key for hundreds of models), any OpenAI-compatible endpoint via OPENAI_BASE_URL , and local models via Ollama, llama.cpp or LLMD . You can also run without an LLM using --no-llm , which drops you into the REPL. See the agent documentation for the full reference. ./lightpanda agent # auto-detects API key from env ./lightpanda agent --task "top story on news.ycombinator.com?" ./lightpanda agent --no-llm # basic REPL, no LLM ./lightpanda run session.js # run a recorded script cat session.js | ./lightpanda run - # ...or pipe one in via stdin ./lightpanda agent --provider gemini --task "..." # force a specific provider ./lightpanda agent --list-models # models available for the detected provider VERTEX_API_KEY=... ./lightpanda agent --provider vertex # Vertex AI, express mode GOOGLE_CLOUD_PROJECT=my-proj ./lightpanda agent --provider vertex # Vertex AI, token via gcloud auth AI_GATEWAY_API_KEY=... ./lightpanda agent --provider vercel --model moonshotai/kimi-k2 # any model behind Vercel AI Gateway OPENROUTER_API_KEY=... ./lightpanda agent --provider openrouter --model anthropic/claude-sonnet-5 # any model behind OpenRouter OPENAI_BASE_URL=https://my-gateway/v1 OPENAI_API_KEY=... ./lightpanda agent # any OpenAI-compatible server Native MCP and skill The MCP server communicates via MCP JSON-RPC 2.0 over stdio. Add to your MCP configuration: { "mcpServers": { "lightpanda": { "command": "/path/to/lightpanda", "args": ["mcp"] } } } HTTP transport and independent sessions For serving several agents from one process, start the MCP server over HTTP instead of stdio by giving it a port (add --host x.x.x.x to specify the interface to listen on): lightpanda mcp --port 9223 Clients POST JSON-RPC to http://host:9223/mcp . Send it on subsequent requests to stay on that session ( isolation ). Two agents that send the same Mcp-Session-Id share one browsing context ( sharing — e.g. a workflow where several agents work the same page). The session_new , session_list and session_close tools manage sessions explicitly. Sending DELETE /mcp with an Mcp-Session-Id closes that session. The run tool runs a PandaScript in the caller's session, as lightpanda run does, and returns its console output and the value it returns. An optional timeout in milliseconds (default 60000) stops a stuck script.
